statement: The Navamsa (D9) is traditionally read as the 'soul' of the birth chart — a subtler confirmation of what the D1 (Rasi) chart promises, consulted above all for marriage and dharma (one's deeper life direction), and for whether a placement's apparent strength in the D1 chart actually holds up under this finer subdivision.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
